release_notes: Build 110 simplifies Create and reorganizes Advanced so routine production stays Autopilot-first.
Create now presents a plain five-step workflow: Setup, Questions, Preview, Details and Finish, replacing the more technical Builder, Draft, Publish and Export wording in the normal sidebar.
Create page guidance now makes it clear which review steps are optional when Autopilot is filling the release schedule.
The manual render and DaVinci Resolve shortcut is removed from the global header; those controls remain available under Create > Finish > Manual settings & render.
The manual export section is renamed Manual settings & render and remains collapsed unless voice, branding, effects, music, format or manual rendering needs an override.
Advanced is reorganized into Publishing & channel, Content & assets, and Troubleshooting & legacy groups.
Projects, Production and Asset Review are moved into a collapsed Troubleshooting & legacy section so older and diagnostic workflows no longer compete with normal tools.
Upload Manager, Release Readiness and platform managers remain immediately accessible for genuine publishing or account-specific work.
All existing routes and production capabilities are preserved; this release changes interface hierarchy only and does not alter upload, scheduling, archive, rendering or Autopilot safety behavior.
Build 109 day-to-day UI cleanup and the guided Needs You workflow remain included unchanged.
